Akali.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Akali’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance early and get enough total health to stay out of execute range. Bring forward your Zhonya's Hourglass purchase to deal with her diving in, and consider penetration to counter Akali’s high magic resistance.
Akali.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Akali approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack as a single trade. Viktor W Gravity Field doesn’t stun immediately, so place it based on Akali’s movement. If the fight continues, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm and use Viktor W Gravity Field to hold her in place while the storm deals damage over time.
Akali.escape: Dodge the first projectile of Akali E Shuriken Flip and look for an engage before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up. If only Akali W Twilight Shroud or Akali E Shuriken Flip is down, she still has another movement option, so don’t chase too soon. When you engage, place Viktor W Gravity Field along her escape route to reduce the time she has to get away.
Akali.fight: When Akali approaches, use Viktor Q Siphon Power for a shield and place Viktor W Gravity Field underfoot or along an escape route. The window before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up is your chance to fight aggressively.
Akali.laning: Use Viktor E Hextech Ray to poke Akali and minions in a line while collecting fragments. Last-hit siege minions yourself to speed up your augment. Secure river vision before pushing the wave, don’t cross the lane midpoint if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, and save Viktor W Gravity Field to stop ganks.
Akali.phase: Viktor has little kill pressure early, so look for health and CS advantages by poking with E and farming before Akali gets her ultimate. When Akali R Perfect Execution is available, watch for her engage and look for an opening after she uses it, before it comes back up. Viktor gets strong in the mid and late game as augments and core items stack, so keep farming even if you fall behind early.
Akali.teamfight: Stay just behind your frontline, watch for Akali’s engage, and be ready with Viktor W Gravity Field and Viktor Q Siphon Power. Cast Viktor R Arcane Storm in narrow terrain and use Viktor W Gravity Field to hold enemies in place while the storm deals damage over time. Recast Viktor R Arcane Storm to steer it toward enemies as they retreat, and use Zhonya's Hourglass to buy time when Akali dives in.
Akali.watch: The most important thing is to dodge the first projectile of Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it marks you, the second dash follows you to wherever you run. You can’t dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking, and its second hit deals more damage the more health you’ve lost, so save Viktor Q Siphon Power and Viktor W Gravity Field for her engage.

Akshan.teamfight: Stay just behind your frontline and overlap Viktor W Gravity Field with Viktor R Arcane Storm in narrow terrain to deal damage over time. Look for a chance to hold Akshan with Viktor W Gravity Field after Akshan E Heroic Swing is down. If you have the Scoundrel mark, don’t face Akshan alone; fight outside his execute range.
Akshan.build: Akshan’s main damage is physical, so start with Cloth Armor and build armor. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots, and bring forward your Zhonya's Hourglass purchase if you need to deal with an assassin diving in.
Akshan.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Akshan steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack as a single trade. In teamfights, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm, hold enemies with Viktor W Gravity Field, then recast the storm to drive it toward enemies as they retreat.
Akshan.escape: Right after you force Akshan to use Akshan E Heroic Swing is your chance to close the gap or catch him out. Place Viktor W Gravity Field along his escape route to make it harder for him to get away. If you push Akshan into an open area without walls, he’ll have trouble using his mobility because there’s no terrain to hook.
Akshan.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Akshan approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field underfoot to slow him. Follow with Viktor Q Siphon Power for a shield and land the empowered basic attack. Right after Akshan E Heroic Swing is used, take advantage of his missing mobility and hold him with Viktor W Gravity Field.
Akshan.laning: Early on, focus on E poke and last-hitting minions rather than kills to build Viktor P Glorious Evolution stacks. Last-hit siege minions yourself, and look for angles to hit Akshan and the wave together with Viktor E Hextech Ray. If you don’t have river vision or don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t cross the lane midpoint, and save Viktor W Gravity Field to stop ganks.
Akshan.phase: Early on, Viktor should survive, farm, and build augments rather than look for kills. Viktor’s strong window is the mid to late game, once he has two or three augments and core items. Even if you fall behind in lane, keep farming to put Viktor in a better position as the game goes on.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits an enemy, so don’t let your guard down behind minions and dodge both passes. When Akshan E Heroic Swing comes in, place Viktor W Gravity Field along his approach. If Akshan R Comeuppance marks you while your health is low, don’t run alone into the open; hide behind terrain.

Ahri.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray, then place Viktor W Gravity Field when Ahri steps forward. Follow with Viktor Q Siphon Power and land the empowered basic attack. Viktor W Gravity Field doesn’t stun immediately, so place it along Ahri’s escape route.
Ahri.escape: If Ahri E Charm is down, pressure her by placing Viktor W Gravity Field along her escape route. Account for the movement speed from Ahri W Fox-Fire; don’t throw W Gravity Field out early without a plan.
Ahri.laning: Move with the minion wave between you and Ahri to dodge Ahri E Charm while poking and farming with Viktor E Hextech Ray. Last-hit siege minions yourself to build evolution stacks. Secure river vision before pushing the wave, and don’t cross the lane midpoint if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is.
Ahri.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance early against Ahri’s main damage, but remember that the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception on its return cannot be reduced by resistance.
Ahri.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Ahri approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field underfoot or along an escape route. When you need to take a trade, use Viktor Q Siphon Power for a shield and follow up with the empowered basic attack.
Ahri.phase: Early on, focus on poking and farming rather than getting kills, and make dodging Ahri E Charm a priority. Viktor gets stronger as he gains evolution stacks and augments, so surviving the early game makes the matchup increasingly favorable in the mid to late game. Keep farming even if you fall behind in lane.
Ahri.teamfight: Stay just behind your frontline, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm, then use Viktor W Gravity Field to hold enemies in place and deal damage over time. Recast the storm to control it and drive it toward enemies as they retreat. Ahri is vulnerable right after Ahri E Charm is down, so pressure her then.
Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits you, you take the damage that follows all at once, so dodge it by standing behind minions. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit on the return, so keep moving outside its return path even after dodging the first pass. Its return true damage cannot be reduced by magic resistance.

Kassadin.phase: In the mid to late game, Viktor has augments from Viktor P Glorious Evolution and his core items, so his damage is strong. However, late-game Kassadin looks for the backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk, so do not stand alone; fight behind your frontline.
Kassadin.build: In the early game, sustain with Null-Magic Mantle first, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Kassadin deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance over armor. If Kassadin R Riftwalk's engage is a threat, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier.
Kassadin.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Kassadin approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field under his feet. Then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack as one combo. In teamfights, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm, hold him with Viktor W Gravity Field, and steer the storm in the direction he retreats.
Kassadin.escape: Then place Viktor W Gravity Field on his escape route to hold Kassadin in place. When chasing, watch Kassadin's mana, since repeated casts increase his mana costs, and counterattack when he runs out.
Kassadin.fight: Damage Kassadin once the shield from Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down. When he steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field under his feet. If you have to trade damage, use the shield from Viktor Q Siphon Power and follow up with the empowered basic attack.
Kassadin.laning: Last-hit siege minions yourself to gain growth for Viktor P Glorious Evolution. Secure river vision before pushing. If you don't know where the enemy jungler is, do not cross the midpoint, and keep Viktor W Gravity Field available to stop a gank.
Kassadin.teamfight: Stand just behind your frontline so you are not Kassadin R Riftwalk's engage target. If Kassadin dives in, hold him with Viktor W Gravity Field and layer Viktor R Arcane Storm on top to deal sustained damage. In narrow terrain, limit his movement with Viktor W Gravity Field and steer Viktor R Arcane Storm in the direction he retreats.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere grants a shield that absorbs magic damage, so poke with Viktor E Hextech Ray after Q is down. Keep Viktor W Gravity Field available so Kassadin cannot slow you with E Force Pulse and engage.

Sylas.escape: At this point, use Viktor W Gravity Field to block the escape route, but watch out for the dash and healing from Sylas W Kingslayer if it is still available.
Sylas.build: Sylas’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Sylas.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray to draw Sylas in, then place Viktor W Gravity Field under him. Follow with Viktor Q Siphon Power and an empowered basic attack as a single combo. If you use Viktor W Gravity Field too early, Sylas can walk out, so wait until you see him approach.
Sylas.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray, and when Sylas approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field under him to slow him. If you need to take a trade, get a shield from Viktor Q Siphon Power and follow with an empowered basic attack. After Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down, look for a chance to keep him in Viktor W Gravity Field.
Sylas.laning: Last-hit siege minions yourself to collect fragments for augments. Before pushing the wave with Viktor E Hextech Ray, secure river vision, and don’t cross the lane midpoint if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is.
Sylas.phase: Early on, Viktor should focus on collecting fragments for augments rather than getting kills. Viktor gets strong in the mid and late game with two or three augments and core items, so keep farming even if you fall behind early.
Sylas.teamfight: Stand just behind your frontline and catch Sylas with Viktor W Gravity Field when he engages with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. In narrow terrain, overlap Viktor R Arcane Storm and steer it toward the direction Sylas retreats to deal damage over time. If you catch Sylas with Viktor W Gravity Field just after he dives in, you have a chance to focus your attacks on him before he heals with Sylas W Kingslayer.
Sylas.watch: If you’re grazed by Sylas Q Chain Lash, immediately leave the intersection where it explodes after a delay. Even a low-health Sylas can heal a lot with Sylas W Kingslayer, so don’t delay finishing him off.

Vex.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Vex’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Build Viktor’s resistances by prioritizing magic resistance to match Vex’s main source of damage.
Vex.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Vex approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field, then follow up with Viktor Q Siphon Power and an empowered basic attack. If Vex dashes in with Vex R Shadow Surge, move toward your allies and trap her entry point with Viktor W Gravity Field. Once she’s trapped, overlap Viktor R Arcane Storm to deal damage over time.
Vex.escape: Look for an opening just after Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear is used on the wave or to poke. If the shield from Vex W Personal Space is also down, block Vex’s escape route with Viktor W Gravity Field.
Vex.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Vex steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field under her, then trade with Viktor Q Siphon Power and an empowered basic attack. Fight aggressively when both Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear and the shield from Vex W Personal Space are down.
Vex.laning: In the early game, build augments by farming and poking with Viktor E Hextech Ray instead of forcing a kill. Last-hit siege minions yourself. Secure river vision before pushing, don’t cross the midpoint if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, and save Viktor W Gravity Field.
Vex.phase: In the early game, Viktor should focus on farming and withstanding Vex’s fear and magic damage instead of looking for kills. Viktor gets stronger in the mid-to-late game as augments stack and core items come online. Keep farming to prepare for that point, even if you fall behind in lane.
Vex.teamfight: Before the fight starts, move low-health allies out of Vex’s range so they aren’t the first takedown target of Vex R Shadow Surge. Fight just behind your frontline, trap enemies in narrow areas with Viktor W Gravity Field, and overlap it with Viktor R Arcane Storm. Recast Viktor R Arcane Storm to steer it after Vex as she retreats.
Vex.watch: While Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear is ready, don’t force close trades. Vex E Looming Darkness grows larger the farther it travels, so if you’re in range, make a short sidestep. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits and marks you, immediately move toward your allies to prepare for her dash.

Anivia.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Anivia’s main damage is magic, and Viktor has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance early.
Anivia.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray, then place Viktor W Gravity Field underfoot when Anivia approaches. Follow with Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack as a single trade. If Anivia Q Flash Frost hits you, get out of Anivia R Glacial Storm rather than continuing the combo.
Anivia.escape: Close the gap during the window when Anivia Q Flash Frost is down. Anivia has no mobility, so once you’re close, place Viktor W Gravity Field along her escape route to catch her. If Anivia W Crystallize is still available, don’t engage through a narrow path.
Anivia.fight: When Anivia Q Flash Frost is down, poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. If Anivia steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and follow with the empowered basic attack. Since it’s difficult to break Anivia P Rebirth alone, bring an ally when you go after the egg.
Anivia.laning: Early on, focus on poking with Viktor E Hextech Ray and last-hitting minions to build fragments for Viktor P Glorious Evolution rather than looking for kills. Last-hit siege minions yourself, and look for an angle to hit Anivia and the wave together with E. If you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t cross the lane midpoint, and save Viktor W Gravity Field to stop ganks.
Anivia.phase: Viktor has little kill pressure early, and Anivia’s crowd control makes it easy to get hit by follow-up attacks, so survive by farming. The more Viktor P Glorious Evolution augments and core items you build in the mid to late game, the more favorable the matchup becomes for Viktor.
Anivia.teamfight: Avoid narrow corridors where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your retreat, and fight in open areas when possible. Stay just behind your frontline, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm, then use Viktor W Gravity Field to hold enemies in place while the storm deals damage over time. Recast R to move it toward enemies as they retreat.
Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost detonates where it is recast and stuns, so Viktor should stay outside its range from the start. If you’re hit by Q or chilled inside Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage, so use Viktor Q Siphon Power for a shield and get out of the storm. Anivia W Crystallize can block your retreat through narrow paths, so keep your distance especially near the river and jungle corridors.

Annie.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Annie’s damage is mostly magic, and Viktor has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance early.
Annie.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray, then place Viktor W Gravity Field underfoot to slow Annie when she steps forward. Follow with Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack. In teamfights, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm and use W to hold enemies in place while the storm deals damage over time.
Annie.escape: The window to pressure Annie is right after she spends Annie P Pyromania’s stun. She has no mobility, so close the gap and place Viktor W Gravity Field then to make it hard for her to escape. Don’t engage when her stun is ready.
Annie.fight: While Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, keep your distance and poke with Viktor E Hextech Ray. After Annie spends her stun and steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field and trade with Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack.
Annie.laning: Early on, build fragments for Viktor P Glorious Evolution by last-hitting minions and poking with Viktor E Hextech Ray rather than looking for kills. Last-hit siege minions yourself, and secure river vision before using E to push the wave. If you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, don’t cross the lane midpoint, and save Viktor W Gravity Field to stop ganks.
Annie.phase: Early on, survive by farming and dodging Annie’s stun. Viktor gets stronger as his Viktor P Glorious Evolution augments and items stack, giving him the advantage in the mid to late game. Keep farming even if you fall behind in the early lane.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie is missing or Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, avoid overlapping positions with allies, and watch out for the area stun from Annie R Summon: Tibbers. Stay just behind your frontline, place Viktor W Gravity Field on Annie as she engages, and overlap it with Viktor R Arcane Storm. Recast R to steer it toward Annie as she retreats.
Annie.watch: When Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, white light swirls around her, so stay outside her ability range during that time. Don’t group together where multiple players can be hit by the area attack from Annie R Summon: Tibbers. After Tibbers is summoned, keep your distance instead of staying where it appeared, even if you’ve killed Annie.

AurelionSol.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Aurelion Sol’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance early, but be wary of choices that greatly increase only your health, since Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health.
AurelionSol.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Aurelion Sol steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack. Viktor W Gravity Field doesn’t stun immediately, so place it based on where Aurelion Sol will remain or the route he will take to escape. In teamfights, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm, hold enemies with Viktor W Gravity Field, then steer Viktor R Arcane Storm toward enemies as they retreat.
AurelionSol.escape: Right after you force Aurelion Sol to use Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is your chance to close the gap. Place Viktor W Gravity Field across his escape route, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack. Prioritize managing your distance if the risk of being caught by Aurelion Sol E Singularity or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend remains.
AurelionSol.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Aurelion Sol approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field underfoot to slow his movement. Follow with Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack as a single trade, using the shield to help with the exchange. Right after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, he has no way to close the gap for a while, so counterattack then.
AurelionSol.laning: Early on, poke with Viktor E Hextech Ray and last-hit minions, especially siege minions, to build augments rather than forcing kills. Manage your distance and angle from behind minions so Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light doesn’t hit you and give him stardust. Secure river vision before pushing the wave, and don’t cross the lane midpoint if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is.
AurelionSol.phase: Aurelion Sol is weak early with little stardust, but Viktor also has little kill pressure early, so pressure his growth with Viktor E Hextech Ray poke and farming. Viktor’s damage becomes strong in the mid to late game with augments and core items. Aurelion Sol also grows stronger from stardust that stacks permanently, so avoid taking unnecessary hits from Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light even in the late game.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Fight just behind your frontline and overlap Viktor W Gravity Field with Viktor R Arcane Storm in narrow terrain to deal damage over time. Place Viktor W Gravity Field along Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight’s approach, and steer Viktor R Arcane Storm toward the enemy as they retreat. Stay spread out from allies so several of you aren’t hit by the empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your maximum health, and hitting you for longer adds damage and stardust, so stand behind minions and quickly leave its targeting line. When your health is low, dodge Aurelion Sol E Singularity, which can execute you, and move outside immediately if you’re caught. In the late game, spread out from allies so you aren’t all caught in the empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.

Aurora.build: Aurora’s damage is mostly magic, and Viktor has relatively low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on maximum health, so prioritize magic resistance over greatly increasing health alone.
Aurora.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Aurora steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack as a single combo. Viktor W Gravity Field does not stun immediately, so place it in Aurora’s escape path. In team fights, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm and hold enemies with Viktor W Gravity Field to deal sustained damage.
Aurora.escape: Your chance to engage comes after Aurora has used both Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding, and Aurora R Between Worlds is still on cooldown. Place Viktor W Gravity Field in Aurora’s escape path and deal damage with Viktor E Hextech Ray. If Aurora gets a takedown, her leap ability’s cooldown resets, so watch for her to re-engage right after an ally is killed.
Aurora.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. If Aurora approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field underfoot to slow her, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power for the shield and follow up with the empowered basic attack. Disengage if health has decreased and Aurora Q Twofold Hex’s return damage would hit.
Aurora.laning: Early on, poke with Viktor E Hextech Ray and kill minions to build augments rather than forcing a kill. Last-hit siege minions yourself, as they grant more fragments. Secure river vision before pushing the wave. If you do not know where the enemy jungler is, do not cross the lane midpoint, and save Viktor W Gravity Field to stop a gank.
Aurora.phase: Early on, focus on surviving, farming, and poking to stack Viktor’s augments. Viktor has a strong period in the mid to late game, once he has two or three augments and his core items. Keep farming even if you fall behind in lane; the longer the game goes, the more it favors Viktor.
Aurora.teamfight: Stand just behind your frontline, overlap Viktor W Gravity Field and Viktor R Arcane Storm to deal sustained damage, and steer the storm toward Aurora’s retreat. If Aurora leaps in and no one dies, look for a chance to hold her with Viktor W Gravity Field. When retreating, do not leave low-health allies behind, reducing Aurora’s chance to leap again after a takedown.
Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, it deals damage again when it returns, and that damage increases the more health you have lost. When you are cursed, move out of the straight line between you and Aurora, and if your health is low, back off before it returns. After Aurora R Between Worlds appears, leaving the area slows you, so decide before it appears whether to create distance or fight inside it.

Azir.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Azir’s magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and build magic resistance first.
Azir.combo: After poking with Viktor E Hextech Ray, place Viktor W Gravity Field when Azir steps forward, then follow Viktor Q Siphon Power with the empowered basic attack. Look for a chance to catch Azir with Viktor W Gravity Field after Azir E Shifting Sands is down. In teamfights, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm, overlap it with Viktor W Gravity Field, then recast Viktor R Arcane Storm to drive it toward Azir as he retreats.
Azir.escape: Right after you force Azir to use Azir E Shifting Sands is your chance to close the gap. When Azir Q Conquering Sands is down and his soldier has stopped in place, move to the side to avoid the line along which the soldier stands. If Azir places a soldier near a wall, account for his path to dash over with Azir E Shifting Sands and place Viktor W Gravity Field along that escape route.
Azir.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Azir approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field underfoot to slow him. Close the gap briefly when Azir Q Conquering Sands is down and his soldiers have stopped, or when Azir E Shifting Sands is down. If you used Viktor Q Siphon Power, follow with the empowered basic attack and then back off.
Azir.laning: Don’t rush for kills; poke with Viktor E Hextech Ray and last-hit minions to build Viktor P Glorious Evolution stacks. Last-hit siege minions yourself, and pressure Azir when his soldiers expire or he runs low on mana. Secure river vision before pushing the wave, and don’t cross the lane midpoint if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is.
Azir.phase: Viktor gets strong in the mid to late game as he builds two or three Viktor P Glorious Evolution augments and core items. Azir also gets stronger as the game goes on, so don’t trade with his soldiers for long in the late game; focus your damage when you catch him.
Azir.teamfight: Stay just behind your frontline and overlap Viktor W Gravity Field with Viktor R Arcane Storm on enemies in narrow terrain. Recast Viktor R Arcane Storm so it follows Azir as he retreats. To avoid several allies being knocked back together by Azir R Emperor's Divide, approach Azir’s team from multiple directions in an open area.
Azir.watch: Don’t stand in a straight line with the soldiers summoned by Azir W Arise!, and check their new position after Azir Q Conquering Sands moves them. Azir R Emperor's Divide knocks you back and leaves a wall briefly, so don’t group up and engage toward Azir’s team in a narrow corridor.

Corki.build: Survive early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Corki’s main damage is physical and Viktor has low armor, so build armor first. Corki P Hextech Munitions’ true damage cannot be blocked by resistances, and while Corki E Gatling Gun hits you, the effects of your resistances are reduced.
Corki.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. If Corki steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field, then land Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack as a single combo. If you cast Viktor W Gravity Field first, Corki can simply walk out, so wait until you see him engage.
Corki.escape: Your window to go in opens right after you make Corki use Corki W Valkyrie. When his mobility is down, place Viktor W Gravity Field to block his escape route. If Corki W Valkyrie is still available, he can escape over terrain if you stick too close.
Corki.fight: Early on, farm and poke with Viktor E Hextech Ray, and place Viktor W Gravity Field underfoot if Corki approaches. Follow with Viktor Q Siphon Power for the shield and the empowered basic attack. Right after Corki W Valkyrie is used, block his escape route with Viktor W Gravity Field and close the distance.
Corki.laning: Corki’s base stats are low during the first five levels, so pressure him with Viktor E Hextech Ray while farming. Last-hit siege minions yourself to collect the fragments needed for augments. Secure river vision before pushing the wave, and do not cross the lane midpoint if you do not know where the enemy jungler is.
Corki.phase: Corki has low base stats during the first five levels, but Viktor also has low kill participation early, so apply pressure through poking and farming. Viktor gets strong in the mid-to-late game once he has two or three augments and his core items. Corki also gets stronger as he builds items, so do not give him time to farm comfortably from the start.
Corki.teamfight: Stand just behind your frontline, avoid Corki’s engage, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm, and hold him with Viktor W Gravity Field. Recast Viktor R Arcane Storm to steer it toward Corki’s retreat. Overlapping the two abilities in a narrow area is good for dealing sustained damage.
Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages units around its first target, so move out of range instead of hiding behind minions. In particular, reposition to avoid repeatedly getting hit by the third missile. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces both your armor and magic resistance while it hits you, so move to the side instead of standing your ground in front of him.

Ekko.build: Build magic resistance first against Ekko’s damage, and survive early with Null-Magic Mantle. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. If Ekko keeps diving in, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier.
Ekko.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Ekko approaches with Ekko E Phase Dive, place Viktor W Gravity Field, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack as a single combo inside the field. In team fights, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm and hold him with Viktor W Gravity Field to deal sustained damage.
Ekko.escape: Start a full fight once both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down. In particular, right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, that mobility tool is down, giving you a chance to hold him with Viktor W Gravity Field. If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, he can still escape with Ekko R Chronobreak, so do not force an engage.
Ekko.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. If Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, place Viktor W Gravity Field underfoot. Follow with Viktor Q Siphon Power for the shield and the empowered basic attack. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, do not chase far even if he looks low.
Ekko.laning: Early on, stack augments through Viktor E Hextech Ray poke and farming rather than going for kills. Last-hit siege minions yourself, and look for an angle to hit Ekko and the wave with one beam. If you do not know where the enemy jungler is, do not cross the lane midpoint, and save Viktor W Gravity Field to stop a gank.
Ekko.phase: Early on, Viktor should survive and focus on farming and stacking augments. Viktor’s strong period is the mid-to-late game, once he has two or three augments and his core items. Keep farming even if you fall behind in lane; the longer the game goes, the more it favors Viktor.
Ekko.teamfight: Stand just behind your frontline and watch for Ekko to engage. Right after he closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, place Viktor W Gravity Field. In a narrow area, overlap Viktor R Arcane Storm with Viktor W Gravity Field and steer the storm toward Ekko’s retreat. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, keep his afterimage’s position in mind and do not chase recklessly.
Ekko.watch: Ekko Q Timewinder’s returning hit deals more damage, so move out of its return path. If you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. If you see Ekko’s afterimage, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so do not chase recklessly even if he is low.

Fizz.build: Fizz’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier as well in case Fizz dives onto you.
Fizz.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. If Fizz steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field, then follow with Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack. Do not use only Viktor Q Siphon Power and back off; weave in other abilities while the empowered basic attack is available. In team fights, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm and hold him with Viktor W Gravity Field to deal sustained damage.
Fizz.escape: Your window to engage and counterattack opens right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster has been fully spent. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available, he can use it to escape, so place Viktor W Gravity Field to block his movement before Fizz E Playful / Trickster comes back up.
Fizz.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. If Fizz approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field underfoot. When you have to take a trade, use Viktor Q Siphon Power for the shield and follow with the empowered basic attack. Counterattack right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster has been fully spent.
Fizz.laning: Early on, stack augments with Viktor E Hextech Ray poke and farming instead of going for kills. Last-hit siege minions yourself, and look to trade when Fizz misses a last-hit with his empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident basic attack. If you have not secured river vision or do not know where the enemy jungler is, do not cross the lane midpoint, and save Viktor W Gravity Field.
Fizz.phase: Early on, focus on surviving Fizz’s magic damage, farming, and stacking augments. Viktor gets strong in the mid-to-late game once he has two or three augments and his core items. Keep farming even if you fall behind in lane; the longer the game goes, the more it favors Viktor.
Fizz.teamfight: Stand close to your allies and make Fizz use Fizz E Playful / Trickster first, then focus him together once it is down. Stand just behind your frontline, overlap Viktor W Gravity Field and Viktor R Arcane Storm, and recast the storm to steer it toward Fizz’s retreat. If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before it erupts.
Fizz.watch: If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts. Fizz may use Fizz Q Urchin Strike to engage at that moment, so place Viktor W Gravity Field in his path to make him use Fizz E Playful / Trickster.

Galio.build: Galio’s damage is mostly magic, and Viktor has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Survive early with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Galio.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. If Galio steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field underfoot, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and land the empowered basic attack. Viktor W Gravity Field does not stun immediately, so do not cast it early when Galio can easily walk out.
Galio.escape: Do not engage just because Galio E Justice Punch is down. Look for an opening before Galio R Hero's Entrance comes off cooldown, and after avoiding Galio W Shield of Durand's taunt, block his escape route with Viktor W Gravity Field.
Galio.fight: Poke Galio first with Viktor E Hextech Ray while he is closing in. If he approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field underfoot to slow him, then follow with Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack. Do not pour damage into Galio while Galio W Shield of Durand is charging; create distance instead.
Galio.laning: Early on, stack augments by last-hitting minions and poking with Viktor E Hextech Ray instead of going for kills. Last-hit siege minions yourself. If Galio uses his abilities to clear the wave and runs low on mana, push the lane to limit his opportunity to use his ultimate to affect other lanes. Secure river vision before pushing, and if you do not know where the enemy jungler is, do not cross the midpoint; save Viktor W Gravity Field to stop a gank.
Galio.phase: Early on, Viktor should farm and avoid Galio’s engages instead of going for kills. Viktor gets strong in the mid-to-late game once he has two or three augments and his core items. Keep farming even if you fall behind in lane; time favors Viktor.
Galio.teamfight: While Galio R Hero’s Entrance is ready, do not start a skirmish against Galio’s team in another lane. Leave the marked area when you see the landing marker. In team fights, stand just behind your frontline, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm in a narrow area, and hold enemies with Viktor W Gravity Field. Recast Viktor R Arcane Storm to steer it toward the enemies’ retreat.
Galio.watch: Galio E Justice Punch can catch Viktor with its dash and knock-up, so dodge when you see the telltale step back. Galio W Shield of Durand reduces incoming damage while charging, so stop attacking and move out of taunt range. Avoid the spot where both gusts from Galio Q Winds of War overlap, and leave the marked area immediately when you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero’s Entrance.

Hwei.build: In the early game, sustain with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Hwei deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first.
Hwei.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Hwei approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field underfoot. Then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and follow up with the empowered basic attack. Viktor W Gravity Field does not stun immediately, so use it after Hwei steps forward.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility ability to create distance, so the moment after Hwei E Subject: Torment is down is your window to engage. Once you close the distance, block the escape route with Viktor W Gravity Field.
Hwei.fight: The moment after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or wave clear is your chance to close the distance. Normally, poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Hwei steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field underfoot to slow Hwei, then trade. If you have to take damage, use the shield from Viktor Q Siphon Power.
Hwei.laning: Last-hit siege minions yourself. If you have augmented E, look for an angle to catch both the wave and Hwei in one line. Secure river vision before pushing the wave, and do not cross the lane's midpoint if you don't know where the enemy jungler is.
Hwei.phase: Early on, Viktor has weak kill participation, so focus on farming while avoiding Hwei's combos. Viktor gets stronger in the midgame once he has augments and core items, and becomes increasingly favored in the late game thanks to the growth he has built up.
Hwei.teamfight: Fight just behind your frontline, and do not lead the engage while Hwei E Subject: Torment is available. In narrow terrain, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm and use Viktor W Gravity Field to hold targets in place while dealing sustained damage. Steer R again in the direction Hwei retreats.
Hwei.watch: If you are hit by Hwei E Subject: Torment's root or forced movement, you are likely to take the follow-up damage too, so do not step forward while this ability is available. If Hwei's first spell hits you, reposition immediately to dodge the second spell and Hwei P Signature of the Visionary's explosion. When slowed by Hwei R Spiraling Despair, do not stay in the same spot.

Irelia.build: In the early game, sustain with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Irelia deals mostly physical damage, and Viktor has low armor, so build armor first.
Irelia.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray, then place Viktor W Gravity Field when Irelia steps forward. After Viktor Q Siphon Power, include the empowered basic attack in the same trade. Viktor W Gravity Field does not stun immediately, so place it according to Irelia's path or slowed position.
Irelia.escape: Right after Irelia uses Q Bladesurge is your chance to close the distance and fight. Place Viktor W Gravity Field along her escape route, then trade with Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack.
Irelia.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Irelia approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field underfoot. Then use Viktor Q Siphon Power for the shield and follow up with the empowered basic attack. Look for a chance to fight right after Irelia uses Q Bladesurge, blocking her escape route with Viktor W Gravity Field.
Irelia.laning: Avoid leaving low-health minions between you and Irelia to limit her approach paths with Irelia Q Bladesurge. Last-hit siege minions yourself to gain stacks toward Viktor P Glorious Evolution, and do not cross the lane's midpoint if you don't know where the enemy jungler is.
Irelia.phase: Then, in the early game, focus on surviving and farming to gain stacks toward Viktor P Glorious Evolution instead of forcing kills. Viktor gets stronger in the mid to late game once you have two or three augments and your core items.
Irelia.teamfight: Prioritize Irelia from just behind your frontline. Cast Viktor R Arcane Storm and use Viktor W Gravity Field to hold her in place while dealing sustained damage. Steer Viktor R Arcane Storm in the direction Irelia retreats.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain-dash to low-health minions to close the distance, so back away when minions are about to die. Watch out for Irelia E Flawless Duet's stun. If you get trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear. Leaving the barrier through the blades deals extra damage and heavily slows you.

Karma.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots early on. Karma’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Karma.combo: Start trades with Viktor E Hextech Ray. If Karma steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field, then follow with Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack. Do not use only Viktor Q Siphon Power and back off; use it together with the empowered basic attack.
Karma.escape: Close the distance and engage after Karma W Focused Resolve is down. If the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E is active, wait for its duration to end, then hold her with Viktor W Gravity Field.
Karma.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. If Karma approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field at your feet to slow her. Follow with Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack. Delay your engage right after Karma activates the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E.
Karma.laning: Early on, stack augments through Viktor E Hextech Ray poke and farming instead of rushing for a kill. Last-hit siege minions yourself, and stand behind minions or outside her range so Karma’s poke does not hit you. If you do not know where the enemy jungler is, do not cross the lane midpoint, and save Viktor W Gravity Field to stop a gank.
Karma.phase: Early on, Viktor should farm while avoiding Karma’s poke instead of going for kills. Viktor is strong in the mid-to-late game once he has two or three augments and his core items. Even if you fall behind in lane, keep farming to prepare for that strong period.
Karma.teamfight: While Karma W Focused Resolve is available, an ally who starts the fight can get caught, so create distance first and make Karma use W. After the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E ends, stand just behind your frontline, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm, and hold enemies with Viktor W Gravity Field. Recast Viktor R Arcane Storm to steer it toward the opponents’ retreat.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame applies an area slow, and the ground left by Karma R Mantra-empowered Q explodes again after a short delay, so move out of its radius. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects to you, it can lead to a root, so use Viktor Q Siphon Power’s shield to absorb damage while creating enough distance to break the tether.

Leblanc.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. LeBlanc deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance, and get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier so you can survive an all-in from an assassin.
Leblanc.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When LeBlanc approaches with W Distortion, place Viktor W Gravity Field, then follow up with Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack. Viktor W Gravity Field does not stun immediately, so place it on her escape route after she steps forward.
Leblanc.escape: The moment after LeBlanc uses W Distortion is your chance to close the distance, but watch whether she still has time to return to her original position. Once the return expires or has already been used, hold her with Viktor W Gravity Field. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, first get out of chain range to avoid the root.
Leblanc.fight: Viktor has no dash to escape, so keep your distance and poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. If LeBlanc approaches with W Distortion, place Viktor W Gravity Field under her feet, then trade with Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack. Continue your counterattack after LeBlanc W Distortion's return expires or has already been used.
Leblanc.laning: Early on, build augments through minion kills and poke with Viktor E Hextech Ray instead of looking for kills, and last-hit siege minions yourself. Secure river vision before pushing the wave, and do not cross the lane's midpoint if you don't know where the enemy jungler is. Alert your team immediately if LeBlanc disappears from mid.
Leblanc.phase: Early on, survive by farming while watching out for LeBlanc's engages and roots. Viktor is strong in the mid to late game once he has augments and core items, so keep farming even if you fall behind in lane.
Leblanc.teamfight: Stand just behind your frontline, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm, and use Viktor W Gravity Field to hold the enemy in place while dealing sustained damage. Steer Viktor R Arcane Storm in the direction the enemy retreats. If LeBlanc engages on you, buy time with Zhonya's Hourglass.
Leblanc.watch: If you are hit by another ability while LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice's mark remains, the damage increases, so back away until the mark disappears. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, get out of chain range before the root takes hold. If LeBlanc P Mirror Image creates a clone, do not cast your abilities immediately; identify which one is attacking you.

Lissandra.build: In the early game, sustain with Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Lissandra deals mostly magic damage, and Viktor has trouble escaping once caught, so build magic resistance and tenacity.
Lissandra.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Lissandra steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack as one combo. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is available, spread out your damage so it does not all land during the stasis from her self-cast.
Lissandra.escape: The moment after Lissandra uses E Glacial Path is your chance to close the distance. If W Ring of Frost is also down, block her escape route with Viktor W Gravity Field and start a trade.
Lissandra.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Lissandra approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field under her feet to slow her. Immediately after Lissandra uses W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it, trade by shielding yourself with Viktor Q Siphon Power and following up with the empowered basic attack.
Lissandra.laning: Farm from an angle that avoids Lissandra Q Ice Shard's piercing path through allied minions. Last-hit siege minions yourself to build fragments for Viktor P Glorious Evolution. Do not force a push without river vision or if you don't know where the enemy jungler is.
Lissandra.phase: Early on, Viktor should focus on surviving and farming rather than getting kills. Viktor gets stronger in the mid to late game once he has two or three augments and his core items, so keep farming even if you fall behind in lane.
Lissandra.teamfight: Stand just behind your frontline and judge your engage distance based on whether Lissandra has used E Glacial Path. In narrow terrain, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm and use Viktor W Gravity Field to hold the enemy, then recast R to drive them in the direction they retreat.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard continues piercing behind a minion after hitting it, so do not stand in line with your allied minions. Lissandra W Ring of Frost roots you, and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb stuns you; either can make you vulnerable to consecutive damage, so keep your distance while both abilities are available.

Lux.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Lux deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first, and get tenacity to deal with Lux Q Light Binding.
Lux.combo: After dodging Lux Q Light Binding, poke with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Lux steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field under her feet or on her escape route. Then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and follow up with the empowered basic attack. Viktor W Gravity Field does not stun immediately, so do not use it early when Lux can easily walk out.
Lux.escape: Engage after Lux Q Light Binding misses. Lux has no mobility ability, so once you close the distance, you can block her escape route with Viktor W Gravity Field. While Lux Q Light Binding is available, watch out for the follow-up attack after the root.
Lux.fight: The moment after dodging Lux Q Light Binding is your chance to close the distance. Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Lux steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field, then follow up with Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack. If you have to take an attack, use Q's shield first.
Lux.laning: Early on, build augments through Viktor E Hextech Ray poke and minion kills instead of looking for kills. Last-hit siege minions yourself, and look for an angle to hit both the wave and Lux with E. Secure river vision before pushing. If you don't know where the enemy jungler is, do not cross the lane's midpoint, and keep Viktor W Gravity Field available to stop a gank.
Lux.phase: Early on, Viktor should focus on surviving and farming rather than looking for kills. Viktor gets stronger in the mid to late game as he collects fragments, stacks augments, and completes core items. Keep farming minions and growing even if you fall behind in lane.
Lux.teamfight: Do not approach grouped with your allies, so Lux E Lucent Singularity cannot catch you all at once. Fight just behind your frontline and layer Viktor W Gravity Field in a narrow passage or on Lux's escape route with Viktor R Arcane Storm. Steer R again in the direction Lux retreats to deal sustained damage.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, its follow-up attacks will land too, so bait out and dodge Q before moving. Do not stand in a straight line with an ally. When the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark appears, move sideways. If you are hit by a spell and marked with Illumination, get out of range of the basic attack that would trigger Lux P Illumination.

Malzahar.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Malzahar’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Malzahar R Nether Grasp deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase your health.
Malzahar.combo: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, remove it first with Viktor E Hextech Ray before fully committing to an attack. Poke with Viktor E Hextech Ray, then when Malzahar approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field and use Viktor Q Siphon Power plus an empowered basic attack as a single combo. In teamfights, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm and hold Malzahar with Viktor W Gravity Field to deal damage over time.
Malzahar.escape: After dodging the silence from Malzahar Q Call of the Void and removing Malzahar P Void Shift, look for a chance to close the distance. Go in when the minions summoned by Malzahar W Void Swarm have disappeared or haven’t spawned yet. Don’t engage alone if Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available.
Malzahar.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray to remove Malzahar P Void Shift. When Malzahar steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field under him, then follow with Viktor Q Siphon Power and an empowered basic attack. If the minions summoned by Malzahar W Void Swarm are already out, clear them with an area-of-effect ability before fighting.
Malzahar.laning: Don’t go for last hits beside a minion afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions; step away until the minion is cleared. Farm with Viktor E Hextech Ray, hitting both the wave and Malzahar, and last-hit siege minions yourself to build Viktor P Glorious Evolution. Secure river vision before pushing the wave, and don’t cross the lane midpoint if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is.
Malzahar.phase: Early on, Viktor should focus on stacking augments through Viktor E Hextech Ray poke and farming rather than going for kills. If Malzahar is pushing the lane and Malzahar P Void Shift has been removed, look for a play with your jungler. Viktor is strong in the mid and late game with augments and core items, but Malzahar W Void Swarm also scales over time, so keep paying attention to the summoned units and managing your spacing.
Malzahar.teamfight: From just behind your frontline, clear the minions summoned by Malzahar W Void Swarm with area-of-effect abilities before fighting. In narrow terrain, overlap Viktor W Gravity Field and Viktor R Arcane Storm, then steer the storm toward the direction the enemy is retreating. If Malzahar R Nether Grasp could be used on an ally, save Viktor R Arcane Storm to interrupt the cast.
Malzahar.watch: When a minion afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect transfers to a nearby enemy, so step away from the wave. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, dodge outside the two portals, and don't start a fight before the silence ends. Malzahar R Nether Grasp is dangerous because it suppresses and deals damage based on maximum health, so don't enter an area without vision alone when his ultimate is available.

Mel.build: In the early game, sustain with Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury's Treads for your boots, and prioritize magic resistance because Mel deals mostly magic damage.
Mel.combo: After Mel W Rebuttal is down, poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Mel steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power followed by the empowered basic attack. When Mel is held within its area, layer Viktor R Arcane Storm to deal sustained damage.
Mel.escape: Close the distance after dodging the center of Mel E Solar Snare and once Mel W Rebuttal is down. Mel has no mobility ability, so once you get close, block her escape route with Viktor W Gravity Field.
Mel.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Mel steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field under her feet. If Mel looks ready to use W Rebuttal, test it first with a basic attack, then use your main abilities after it is down. After dodging the center of Mel E Solar Snare, look for a chance to close the distance.
Mel.laning: Build stacks toward Viktor P Glorious Evolution through farming and Viktor E Hextech Ray poke instead of forcing kills. Last-hit siege minions yourself, and line up Viktor E Hextech Ray to hit both the wave and Mel. Secure river vision before pushing, and do not cross the midpoint if you don't know where the enemy jungler is.
Mel.phase: Early on, Viktor has low kill participation, so focus on farming and poking while pressuring the lane to limit Mel's chances to build growth stacks. Viktor deals strong damage in the mid to late game once he has two or three augments and core items. Mel also grows stronger over time because her stacks from Mel R Golden Eclipse remain permanently, so keep limiting her opportunities to grow.
Mel.teamfight: Fight just behind your frontline and place Viktor W Gravity Field in a narrow passage or on Mel's escape route. Layer Viktor R Arcane Storm and steer it in the direction Mel retreats to deal sustained damage. Confirm Mel W Rebuttal is down before using your main abilities. If you leave a fight with Overwhelm stacks, wait in a safe spot for them to disappear.
Mel.watch: Mel E Solar Snare roots you if you are hit in its center, so dodge to the side. If Overwhelm from Mel P Searing Brilliance has accumulated, you can be executed even while you still have health. Mel R Golden Eclipse can reach you from far away, so after a fight, wait in a safe spot for the stacks to disappear.

Naafiri.build: In the early game, sustain with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Naafiri deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first. Since you are dealing with an assassin who dives onto you, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier as well.
Naafiri.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Naafiri steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field. Then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack as one combo. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, save your targeted abilities and use them after it ends.
Naafiri.escape: Do not engage just because either Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers or E Eviscerate is down. Look for an opening before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes off cooldown and while her other mobility tools are also down, then block her escape route with Viktor W Gravity Field.
Naafiri.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Naafiri approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field under her feet to slow her. Then use Viktor Q Siphon Power for the shield and follow up with the empowered basic attack. Right after Naafiri uses E Eviscerate, look for a chance to counterattack while clearing the revived pack with area damage.
Naafiri.laning: Farm from behind your minion wave, hitting both Naafiri and the wave with Viktor E Hextech Ray. Last-hit siege minions yourself to gain growth for Viktor P Glorious Evolution. If you don't know where the enemy jungler is, do not cross the lane's midpoint, and keep Viktor W Gravity Field available to stop an engage or gank.
Naafiri.phase: Early on, build augments by surviving through farming and Viktor E Hextech Ray poke instead of looking for kills. Watch Naafiri's roams closely in the midgame and maintain wide vision. Viktor gets stronger in the mid to late game once he has augments and core items, so fight with your team instead of getting caught alone.
Naafiri.teamfight: Stand just behind your frontline, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm, and use Viktor W Gravity Field to hold enemies in place while dealing sustained damage. Steer Viktor R Arcane Storm in the direction they retreat. Group up so Naafiri's pack is hit by area damage, and retreat right after an ally dies, watching out for a recast of Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit.
Naafiri.watch: If you are hit once by Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and start bleeding, the second Q deals more damage, so back away until the bleed ends. Naafiri E Eviscerate can dash and revive her pack, and Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit targets a champion and dashes to them, so do not travel alone while Naafiri has R available.

Orianna.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Orianna deals mostly magic damage, and Viktor tends to have low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Orianna.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray, then place Viktor W Gravity Field under Orianna when she steps forward. Follow with Viktor Q Siphon Power and an empowered basic attack as a single combo.
Orianna.escape: After the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance and the forced movement from Orianna R Command: Shockwave are down, look for a chance to close the distance. Since Orianna has no way to create distance on her own, block her escape route with Viktor W Gravity Field once you’re on top of her.
Orianna.fight: Early on, don’t take extended trades against the empowered basic attacks from Orianna P Clockwork Windup; poke with Viktor E Hextech Ray instead. Look for a trade right after Orianna Q Command: Attack throws the ball, when it is away from her and Orianna E Command: Protect’s sustained defensive stats aren’t active.
Orianna.laning: Rather than rushing for a kill, poke with Viktor E Hextech Ray and last-hit minions, especially siege minions, yourself to build stacks for Viktor P Glorious Evolution. Secure river vision before pushing the wave, and don’t cross the lane midpoint if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is.
Orianna.phase: Early on, watch out for Orianna’s empowered basic attacks and focus on farming and surviving as Viktor. Viktor gains the advantage in the mid and late game as Viktor P Glorious Evolution augments stack and core items come together, so keep farming even if you fall behind in lane.
Orianna.teamfight: Watch the ball’s position rather than Orianna herself and avoid spots where Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in. From just behind your frontline, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm in narrow terrain and hold enemies with Viktor W Gravity Field, then recast the storm to steer it toward the direction they retreat.
Orianna.watch: Watch where the ball lands after Orianna Q Command: Attack and move accordingly. You can be pulled in by Orianna R Command: Shockwave near the ball, so move away from it, and watch out for the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance.

Qiyana.build: Qiyana’s main damage is physical, so start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Since Qiyana is an assassin who closes in on you, get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier as well.
Qiyana.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Qiyana approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field under her to slow her, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and an empowered basic attack as a single combo. In teamfights, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm, hold Qiyana with W, then recast R to drive the storm toward the direction she retreats.
Qiyana.escape: Don’t engage just because Qiyana W Terrashape is down. Wait until Qiyana E Audacity has also been used; especially before E comes back up, block her escape route with Viktor W Gravity Field and counterattack.
Qiyana.fight: Keep your distance while Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity are available. If Qiyana uses her abilities and remains in front of you, poke with Viktor E Hextech Ray and counter when she approaches by placing Viktor W Gravity Field where she’s headed. When trading, get a shield from Viktor Q Siphon Power and follow with an empowered basic attack.
Qiyana.laning: Early on, build stacks for Viktor P Glorious Evolution with minion kills and Viktor E Hextech Ray pokes rather than going for kills. Last-hit siege minions yourself, and if you’ve augmented E, line up the wave and Qiyana with it. Don’t cross the lane midpoint if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, and save Viktor W Gravity Field.
Qiyana.phase: Early on, focus on farming and surviving as Viktor. Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so don’t give her an advantage then, and build armor. Viktor gets strong in the mid and late game once augments and core items come together, so keep farming even if you fall behind.
Qiyana.teamfight: Stand just behind your frontline and avoid walls and narrow passages to deny Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent an angle. When Qiyana engages, catch her with Viktor W Gravity Field and overlap Viktor R Arcane Storm to deal damage over time. When you need to withstand Qiyana’s attacks, cast R and then use Zhonya’s Hourglass to buy time.
Qiyana.watch: When Qiyana approaches with the river element, step outside the root range of Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. If she disappears with the brush element, move into allied vision, and keep your distance from Qiyana with the rock element when health is below half. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes when it hits a wall, so don’t stand with your back to a wall or encounter her in a narrow passage by the river.

Ryze.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Ryze’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots and build magic resistance first.
Ryze.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray, and when Ryze approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field where he stands. Follow with Viktor Q Siphon Power and an empowered basic attack as a single combo. In teamfights, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm, then pressure Ryze with Viktor W Gravity Field to keep him in its area.
Ryze.escape: While Ryze R Realm Warp is down, look for a chance to catch Ryze with Viktor W Gravity Field. If you dodged Ryze E Spell Flux, Ryze W Rune Prison only slows you instead of rooting you, making it a good window to trade.
Ryze.fight: When Ryze steps forward, poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. If you need to take a trade, get a shield from Viktor Q Siphon Power and follow with an empowered basic attack.
Ryze.laning: Rather than forcing a kill early, poke with Viktor E Hextech Ray and last-hit minions, especially siege minions, yourself to stack augments. Slow Ryze’s growth with poke before he gets items, but don’t cross the lane midpoint if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is. Secure river vision before pushing the wave, and save Viktor Q Siphon Power and Viktor W Gravity Field.
Ryze.phase: Early on, neither champion can easily get a kill, so slow Ryze’s growth with poke and farming while stacking Viktor’s augments. The mid and late game, with two or three augments and core items, is Viktor’s strong point. Keep farming and look toward that point even if you fall behind in lane.
Ryze.teamfight: Stand just behind your frontline and check whether you’re marked by Ryze E Spell Flux; if you are, move away from your allies. In narrow terrain, overlap Viktor W Gravity Field and Viktor R Arcane Storm, then recast Viktor R Arcane Storm to drive the storm toward the direction Ryze retreats. If Ryze casts R Realm Warp, look for a chance to interrupt Ryze himself with the stun from Viktor W Gravity Field.
Ryze.watch: If you’re hit by Ryze E Spell Flux, keep your distance from allies until the mark disappears. While marked, Ryze W Rune Prison roots you and Ryze Q Overload is empowered, so dodge Ryze E Spell Flux first.

Syndra.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Syndra’s main magic damage, while also considering enough total health to withstand the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Syndra approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field, then follow with Viktor Q Siphon Power and an empowered basic attack. If you close the distance after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, place Viktor W Gravity Field on her escape route to look for a stun.
Syndra.escape: The moment Syndra E Scatter the Weak is used is a chance to go in. Before then, move off the line of Syndra Q Dark Sphere to dodge the stun; once Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, block her escape route with Viktor W Gravity Field.
Syndra.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray, and when Syndra steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field under her. When you have to take damage, use the shield from Viktor Q Siphon Power and follow with an empowered basic attack. Look for an opening right after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is used, while her self-defense tool is down.
Syndra.laning: Early on, stack augments with Viktor E Hextech Ray pokes and farming rather than going for kills. Last-hit siege minions yourself, and secure river vision before pushing the wave. Don’t cross the lane midpoint if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, and save Viktor W Gravity Field to stop ganks.
Syndra.phase: Early on, Viktor is better off farming while withstanding Syndra’s poke than going for kills. Viktor peaks in the mid and late game once he has two or three augments and core items. Keep farming even if you fall behind early, and the matchup becomes more favorable for Viktor as the game goes on.
Syndra.teamfight: Stand just behind your frontline, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm, and hold enemies with Viktor W Gravity Field to deal damage over time. Recast Viktor R Arcane Storm to drive it toward the direction the enemy retreats. Avoid areas where several Syndra Q Dark Spheres are on the ground, and move off the line of spheres that Syndra E Scatter the Weak can stun with.
Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere lands between Syndra and Viktor, Syndra E Scatter the Weak can knock it into you and stun you, so move off the line of the sphere. If several Syndra Q Dark Spheres are on the ground in an area, watch out for the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power and reposition.

Talon.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game to build armor. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots, and rush Zhonya's Hourglass if Talon keeps sticking to you. Talon tends to have high magic resistance, so consider magic penetration when building damage later.
Talon.combo: Start trades with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Talon approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field, then follow up with Viktor Q Siphon Power and an empowered basic attack. Viktor W Gravity Field does not stun immediately, so place it based on Talon’s movement. In teamfights, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm and trap enemies with Viktor W Gravity Field to deal its damage over time.
Talon.escape: The moment after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is a chance to close the distance and retaliate. Dodge the return path of Talon W Rake, then block his route with Viktor W Gravity Field and attack. Don’t chase far if Talon E Assassin's Path and Talon R Shadow Assault are still available.
Talon.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Talon approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field under him, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power for a shield and follow up with the empowered basic attack. Look for a chance to retaliate once you confirm Talon R Shadow Assault has been used.
Talon.laning: Last-hit siege minions yourself to build stacks for Viktor P Glorious Evolution. Before pushing the wave with Viktor E Hextech Ray, secure river vision. If you spot Talon roaming with Talon E Assassin's Path, communicate his position.
Talon.phase: Avoid Talon’s strong early trades and focus on farming and surviving as Viktor. Viktor becomes favored in the mid-to-late game as Viktor P Glorious Evolution stacks, augments, and core items come online. Keep farming and prepare for late-game teamfights even if you fall behind in lane.
Talon.teamfight: Fight just behind your frontline and trap Talon with Viktor W Gravity Field if he gets onto your backline. In narrow areas, overlap it with Viktor R Arcane Storm and steer the storm toward Talon’s retreat path. While Talon is on top of you, use Zhonya's Hourglass to buy time and make use of the storm’s damage over time.
Talon.watch: Talon W Rake becomes a stronger combo with Talon P Blade's End if it hits on both the outward and returning paths. If you’re hit on the first pass, immediately move out of the return path.

TwistedFate.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Twisted Fate’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots and prioritize magic resistance.
TwistedFate.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Twisted Fate steps forward, slow him with Viktor W Gravity Field, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and follow with an empowered basic attack. Viktor W Gravity Field doesn’t stun immediately, so don’t cast it too early in a spot Twisted Fate can easily walk out of.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is used is a chance to go in.
TwistedFate.fight: Keep your distance while Twisted Fate is holding a gold card from W Pick a Card. If he’s holding a blue or red card, or just used a card, poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray; when he approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field, then trade with Viktor Q Siphon Power and an empowered basic attack.
TwistedFate.laning: Line up Viktor E Hextech Ray to hit both the wave and Twisted Fate, but secure river vision before pushing. Don’t cross the lane midpoint if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, and save Viktor W Gravity Field to stop ganks.
TwistedFate.phase: Early on, Viktor should focus on surviving, farming, and poking. Viktor gets strong in the mid and late game once he has two or three augments and core items, so keep farming even if you fall behind early.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Stand just behind your frontline, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm, and hold enemies with Viktor W Gravity Field to deal damage over time. Recast Viktor R Arcane Storm to steer it toward the direction they retreat. If you see Twisted Fate R Destiny being cast within range, look for a chance to interrupt his movement with crowd control.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has locked in a gold card, don’t enter basic attack range, since its empowered basic attack stuns. Stand behind minions to reduce damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.

Veigar.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Veigar’s magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for tenacity against Veigar E Event Horizon.
Veigar.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Veigar steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field to slow him, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and an empowered basic attack together. When you see the marker for Veigar W Dark Matter, keep moving to dodge instead of standing still to basic attack.
Veigar.escape: Once Veigar E Event Horizon is down, you have a chance to close the distance. Veigar has no mobility, so if you get in, block his escape route with Viktor W Gravity Field.
Veigar.fight: Pressure Veigar with Viktor E Hextech Ray in the early game, but keep farming instead of forcing a kill. If Veigar approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field under him, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and follow up with an empowered basic attack. Keep moving during trades to dodge Veigar W Dark Matter.
Veigar.laning: Position behind minions so Veigar Q Baleful Strike doesn’t hit you and help him scale. Last-hit siege minions yourself to build Viktor P Glorious Evolution stacks, and look for an angle to hit both the wave and Veigar with Viktor E Hextech Ray. Secure river vision before pushing, and don’t cross the lane midpoint if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is.
Veigar.phase: Early on, Veigar has few scaling stacks and no mobility, so pressure him with Viktor E Hextech Ray and disrupt his farming. Viktor gets stronger in the mid-to-late game as augments and core items come online, so keep farming even if you don’t get an early kill.
Veigar.teamfight: Fight just behind your frontline while tracking Veigar E Event Horizon and Veigar’s position. In narrow areas, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm and trap enemies with Viktor W Gravity Field to deal damage over time. Recast Viktor R Arcane Storm to steer it toward Veigar’s retreat path.
Veigar.watch: Veigar W Dark Matter’s landing spot and timing are visible, so watch the ground marker and sidestep. If you’re trapped inside Veigar E Event Horizon, don’t cross the edge; move within it and wait for it to disappear. If health drops below half, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on missing health.

Vladimir.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first because Vladimir’s primary damage is magic. If extended fights make his healing a problem, build Grievous Wounds next.
Vladimir.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray to draw out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool. Once the pool ends and Vladimir approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field under him to slow him, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and an empowered basic attack together. Steer Viktor R Arcane Storm toward Vladimir’s retreat path to deal damage over time.
Vladimir.escape: Once Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends, you have a chance to trap him with Viktor W Gravity Field. Vladimir moves more slowly while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, giving you time to position away from its damage and close the distance.
Vladimir.fight: Bait out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first. Once Vladimir steps forward, block his retreat with Viktor W Gravity Field, then trade with Viktor Q Siphon Power and an empowered basic attack.
Vladimir.laning: Last-hit siege minions yourself to build Viktor P Glorious Evolution fragments. Look for an angle to hit both the wave and Vladimir with Viktor E Hextech Ray. Secure river vision before pushing, and don’t cross the lane midpoint if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is.
Vladimir.phase: Instead of forcing kills early, Viktor should farm and poke to build augments. Viktor gets stronger in the mid-to-late game with two or three augments and core items, so keep farming even if you fall behind early.
Vladimir.teamfight: Don’t group together where multiple allies can be hit by Vladimir R Hemoplague. If you’re infected, step back until the effect ends. Fight just behind your frontline, trap Vladimir with Viktor W Gravity Field, overlap Viktor R Arcane Storm, then steer the storm toward his retreat path.
Vladimir.watch: When Vladimir charges Vladimir E Tides of Blood, put minions between you or move out of range. If you’re afflicted by Vladimir R Hemoplague, the damage you take increases, so back off until the effect ends. Don’t try to trap Vladimir with Viktor W Gravity Field while Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is available.

Xerath.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Xerath deals magic damage, so magic resistance is the resistance Viktor needs.
Xerath.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Xerath steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field under him or along his escape route, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and an empowered basic attack together. Viktor W Gravity Field doesn’t stun immediately, so place it where Xerath will have trouble walking out.
Xerath.escape: The moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down is your chance to engage. Xerath has no mobility, so close the distance then and block his escape route with Viktor W Gravity Field.
Xerath.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray to make Xerath step forward. Once Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, close the distance, place Viktor W Gravity Field along his escape route, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and follow up with an empowered basic attack.
Xerath.laning: Early on, prioritize killing minions and building Viktor P Glorious Evolution stacks over getting kills. Last-hit siege minions yourself, and look for an angle to hit both the wave and Xerath with Viktor E Hextech Ray. Secure river vision before pushing, and don’t cross the midpoint if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is.
