Xerath.phase: Endure Xerath’s long range early and farm with Viktor E Hextech Ray. If you hold out while avoiding his heavy damage, you can push the wave and call your jungler when mana runs dry first. Viktor gets stronger in the mid-to-late game as Viktor P Glorious Evolution augments and core items come online.
Xerath.teamfight: Fight just behind your frontline, trap enemies with Viktor W Gravity Field, and overlap it with Viktor R Arcane Storm to deal damage over time. Recast Viktor R Arcane Storm to steer it toward Xerath’s retreat path. If you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane being cast and are close enough to interrupt it, use Viktor R Arcane Storm to interrupt the cast.
Xerath.watch: Be especially wary of Xerath E Shocking Orb, since its stun can leave you open to his full follow-up. Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so when you see him charging it, change direction and sidestep. Walk out immediately when Xerath W Eye of Destruction lands.

Yasuo.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against Yasuo’s main damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. If Yasuo keeps sticking to you and trades are hard to survive, rush Zhonya's Hourglass.
Yasuo.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Yasuo approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field under him or along his movement path, then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and an empowered basic attack together. Yasuo W Wind Wall can’t block beam-shaped abilities, so line up Viktor E Hextech Ray.
Yasuo.escape: The moment after Yasuo throws his tornado is your chance to engage. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can be recast shortly after use, so don’t chase far just because he used it once. Look for a trade when you can trap him with Viktor W Gravity Field before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up.
Yasuo.fight: Use light poke to break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield before committing to a trade. Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, he briefly has no way to knock you up, so poke with Viktor E Hextech Ray and use Viktor W Gravity Field to counter if he approaches. If Viktor Q Siphon Power gives you a shield, follow up with an empowered basic attack and use the movement speed to create distance.
Yasuo.laning: Early on, focus on last-hitting minions and building Viktor P Glorious Evolution stacks rather than getting kills, and last-hit siege minions yourself. Keeping the wave thin near your side of the lane reduces the number of minions Yasuo can use to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Secure river vision before pushing with Viktor E Hextech Ray, and don’t cross the lane midpoint if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is.
Yasuo.phase: In the early game, Viktor should focus on managing distance and farming while enduring Yasuo’s approaches. Viktor gets stronger in the mid-to-late game as two or three augments and core items come online. Keep farming minions and building augments even if you fall behind in lane.
Yasuo.teamfight: Position just behind your frontline to avoid becoming Yasuo’s engage target. Cast Viktor R Arcane Storm, then overlap it with Viktor W Gravity Field to trap enemies and deal damage over time. Recast the storm to steer it toward the enemy’s retreat path.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade lets him approach through minions, so watch your distance in areas with many minions. After Yasuo lands Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice, his next Q knocks enemies up; watch for the sound and visual effect, then sidestep out of its line. A knockup can lead into Yasuo R Last Breath, so keep your distance especially when his tornado is ready.

Yone.build: Rush Zhonya's Hourglass to prepare for Yone diving onto you. Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone P Way of the Hunter deal different damage types, so consider building both armor and magic resistance. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a large amount of health.
Yone.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Yone approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field, then follow up with Viktor Q Siphon Power and an empowered basic attack. Viktor W Gravity Field doesn’t stun immediately, so place it across his escape route after he steps forward. If the fight goes long, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm and trap enemies with Viktor W Gravity Field to deal damage over time.
Yone.escape: When Yone has used only one mobility ability, he still has another way to move, so don’t force an engage. Look for a window after Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado and Yone E Soul Unbound are down, especially before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up. Then block his retreat with Viktor W Gravity Field and attack with Viktor E Hextech Ray and Viktor Q Siphon Power.
Yone.fight: Usually, poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Yone steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field to counter his engage. After Yone dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, look for a chance to stop his return with the stun from Viktor W Gravity Field.
Yone.laning: Build augments by using Viktor E Hextech Ray to poke and farm at the same time, and last-hit siege minions yourself. If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, create distance and watch for his tornado. Don’t cross the lane midpoint when you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, and save Viktor W Gravity Field to stop ganks.
Yone.phase: After that, Viktor should focus on farming and building augments instead of looking for kills while enduring Yone’s engages. Viktor gets stronger in the mid-to-late game as augments and core items come online, so deal damage over time in teamfights.
Yone.teamfight: Stand just behind your frontline, but don’t position alone at the very back of the formation where Yone R Fate Sealed can reach you. Spread out from allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave doesn’t hit several of you at once. When Yone engages, trap him with Viktor W Gravity Field, overlap it with Viktor R Arcane Storm, then steer the storm toward his retreat path.
Yone.watch: Yone Q Mortal Steel can stack by hitting minions, then dash forward with a tornado and knock you up. When the tornado is ready, stay out of range until the stacks disappear. Save Viktor W Gravity Field for when Yone dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, and move out of the path of Yone R Fate Sealed.

Zed.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first because Zed’s primary damage is physical. Also rush Zhonya's Hourglass to prepare for when Zed dives onto you.
Zed.combo: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Zed steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field, then follow up with Viktor Q Siphon Power and an empowered basic attack. Viktor W Gravity Field doesn’t stun immediately, so don’t cast it too early when Zed can easily walk out. In teamfights, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm and trap enemies with Viktor W Gravity Field to deal damage over time.
Zed.escape: Don’t blindly engage right after Zed uses Zed W Living Shadow; wait until the shadow disappears or Zed has already switched places. If Zed R Death Mark is also unavailable, fight while blocking his escape route with Viktor W Gravity Field.
Zed.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. When Zed approaches, place Viktor W Gravity Field under him. Look for a trade after Zed W Living Shadow disappears or after Zed has already switched places. Use Viktor Q Siphon Power for its shield and follow up with an empowered basic attack.
Zed.laning: Early on, build Viktor P Glorious Evolution stacks through last-hitting and poking with Viktor E Hextech Ray instead of looking for kills. Last-hit siege minions yourself. Secure river vision before pushing, don’t cross the lane midpoint if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is, and save Viktor W Gravity Field to stop ganks.
Zed.phase: Early on, Viktor should focus on surviving and farming instead of looking for kills. Zed is strong in the mid game, so avoid getting caught alone and focus on building Viktor’s augments and core items. Zed gets weaker and Viktor gets stronger as the game goes late, so fight with your allies.
Zed.teamfight: Stand just behind your frontline and place Viktor W Gravity Field in a narrow passage or along Zed’s engage route, then overlap it with Viktor R Arcane Storm. If Zed dives in with Zed R Death Mark, use Viktor W Gravity Field while the mark is active to interrupt his combo and reduce the damage he can stack. Recast Viktor R Arcane Storm to move it toward the enemy’s retreat path.
Zed.watch: Watch the position of Zed W Living Shadow and move outside the slow area of Zed E Shadow Slash. When Zed dives in with Zed R Death Mark, he tries to stack damage until the mark detonates, so use Viktor W Gravity Field to limit how long he can stay on you. Zed Q Razor Shuriken, Zed E Shadow Slash, and Zed R Death Mark mainly deal physical damage; armor does not block the magic damage from Zed P Contempt for the Weak.

Zoe.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Since most of Zoe’s damage is magic, build magic resistance first. However, Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble’s true damage cannot be reduced by resistance, so prioritize dodging the bubble.
Zoe.combo: When Zoe approaches, trade in this order: Viktor E Hextech Ray → Viktor W Gravity Field → Viktor Q Siphon Power → empowered basic attack. If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, place Viktor W Gravity Field at her starting point in advance, before she returns. In teamfights, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm and use Viktor W Gravity Field to hold enemies in place while dealing sustained damage.
Zoe.escape: The moment Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble misses is your chance to counterattack. If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, target the spot where she’ll return.
Zoe.fight: Poke first with Viktor E Hextech Ray. If Zoe steps forward, place Viktor W Gravity Field to slow her. Then use Viktor Q Siphon Power and the empowered basic attack as one combo. Look to counterattack when Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down.
Zoe.laning: Early on, build up augments by poking with Viktor E Hextech Ray and farming rather than looking for kills. Last-hit siege minions yourself, and look for an angle to hit both the wave and Zoe with Viktor E Hextech Ray. Secure river vision before pushing the wave, and don’t go past the midline if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is.
Zoe.phase: Early on, withstand Zoe’s attacks and focus on farming and augments. Viktor grows stronger as he stacks them, and hits his stride in the mid to late game once he has two or three augments and core items. Keep farming and scaling even if you fall behind in lane.
Zoe.teamfight: Stay just behind your frontline and watch for the angle of Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. In narrow terrain, cast Viktor R Arcane Storm and use Viktor W Gravity Field to hold enemies in place while dealing sustained damage. Recast Viktor R Arcane Storm to steer it after enemies as they retreat.
Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, you’ll fall asleep after a short delay and can take heavy damage from Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Before the sleep takes effect, move behind a wall or an ally to get out of Zoe Q Paddle Star!’s angle and range. Even if Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble misses, it remains as a trap, so be careful in narrow paths without vision.
